newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary MFB says H1 performance in line with plan.
newsitem.headline: Hungary MFB says H1 performance in line with plan.

text.p: Hungary's state owned Magyar Fejlesztesi Bank Rt's (MFB Rt) achievements in the first half of the year were in harmony with its plans, the bank's management said on Thursday.
"The (bank's) performance in the first half of the year is in line with the plans," Maria Kende, Deputy General Director told a news conference.
Bank officials could not give profit figures for the first six months of the year.

However, CEO Andras Huszty said that first half profits would probably exceed the proportional part of the annual pre-tax profit plan of 3.2 billion forints ($17 million) as the bank expected the first six months to be stronger than the second half of the year.
Kende said MFB's balance sheet total exceeded 100 billion forints at the end of June, compared to 91.97 billion forints at the end of 1996.
-- Emese Bartha, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327-4040 ($ = 188.6 Hungarian Forints)
